sum: Huckleberry.ai, Inc. designs and develops a cloud-based data platform. The company's platform connects employees across organizations with data, systems, and people, providing access to real-time data and insights. It offers data analytics, visualization, workflow automation, and artificial intelligence-driven decision-making capabilities. The company's data science suite incorporates machine learning algorithms, predictive analytics, and artificial intelligence tools that identify patterns and correlations, generate alerts, and initiate business processes. The company also provides professional services. Additionally, the company organizes Domopalooza, an annual user conference. It serves customers in financial services, healthcare, energy, and technology industries across North America, Western Europe, Australia, Japan, and India. Huckleberry.ai, Inc. was formerly known as Domo, Inc. and changed its name to Huckleberry.ai, Inc. in September 2026. Huckleberry.ai, Inc. was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Lehi, Utah.
ceo: Mr. Joshua G. James (Founder, CEO & Director)
